lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Explain the Menú del Día to a Newly Arrived Friend
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Explain step by step how a fixed-price lunch works and why, then have your friend explain it back.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are explaining the menú del día to the AI, your Brazilian friend Lucas, at a casa de comidas in Zaragoza: walk him through each course and why it is cheap, using primero, luego, porque and por eso, then have him explain it back.
lessons.title: Explain a Fixed-Price Lunch to a Friend
lessons.objective: Explain the parts and price of a French fixed-price lunch, then ask your friend to explain the order back.
lessons.focus: Use d’abord, ensuite, parce que and donc for sequence and cause; ask your friend to reformulate.
lessons.scene: Maya explains a posted lunch formula at a neighborhood café to her newly arrived friend Lucas.

cards.fr: La formule comprend une entrée et un plat.
cards.en: The fixed-price lunch includes a starter and a main course.

cards.fr: Le dessert coûte trois euros de plus.
D’abord, tu choisis l’entrée ; ensuite, le plat.
cards.en: First, you choose the starter; then the main course.

cards.fr: Cette formule coûte moins cher parce que le choix est limité.
cards.en: This fixed-price lunch costs less because the choice is limited.

cards.fr: Tu peux me redire ce qui est compris ?
cards.en: Can you tell me again what is included?

cards.fr: Donc le dessert est en supplément.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Regarde la formule du midi sur la carte.
reader.en: Look at the fixed-price lunch on the menu.

reader.speaker: Lucas
reader.fr: Qu’est-ce qui est compris ?
reader.en: What is included?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: D’abord, tu choisis une entrée ; ensuite, un plat principal.
reader.en: First, you choose a starter; then a main course.

reader.speaker: Lucas
reader.fr: Et le dessert ?
reader.en: And dessert?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Le dessert coûte trois euros de plus. Il est en supplément.
reader.en: Dessert costs three euros extra. It has a surcharge.

reader.speaker: Lucas
reader.fr: Pourquoi la formule coûte moins cher ?
reader.en: Why does the fixed-price lunch cost less?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Parce que le choix est limité ici. Tu peux me redire ce qui est compris ?
reader.en: Because the choices are limited here. Can you tell me again what is included?

reader.speaker: Lucas
reader.fr: Une entrée et un plat sont compris. Le dessert coûte trois euros de plus.
reader.en: A starter and a main course are included. Dessert costs three euros extra.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Exactement. Maintenant, nous pouvons commander.
reader.en: Exactly. Now we can order.

speaking.opening: Regarde la formule du midi sur la carte.
speaking.goal: Explain the included courses, three-euro dessert supplement and reason for the price, then ask the friend to teach it back.
wordBank: La formule comprend une entrée et un plat.
Le dessert coûte trois euros de plus.
D’abord, tu choisis l’entrée ; ensuite, le plat.
Cette formule coûte moins cher parce que le choix est limité.
Tu peux me redire ce qui est compris ?
Donc le dessert est en supplément.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French term for a fixed-price lunch.

type.cueEnglish: Type the sequence connector for then.

say.cueEnglish: Explain why this formula costs less here.

write.cueEnglish: Ask the friend to repeat what is included.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The menu composition, price and reason for the price are specific to this fictional café; do not present them as universal French practice. Qualified French review required.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Why the Kitchen Closes at Four: Explaining Local Rhythm
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Explain to a fellow traveler how lunch hours, sobremesa and closures work here, and check your facts with staff.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are the traveler who knows the local rhythm, and the AI is Femke, an annoyed backpacker in a Seville tapas bar: explain lunch hours, sobremesa and closures using impersonal se and si + present, then check your facts with the bartender.
lessons.title: Explain a Café’s Lunch Rhythm
lessons.objective: Explain this café’s lunch hours, time spent talking after the meal, and afternoon closure to a traveler, then check the details with staff.
lessons.focus: Use on, si + present, and est-ce que for a local pattern, conditional case and confirmation with the café.
lessons.scene: At a neighborhood café, Femke asks Maya why the kitchen stops lunch orders at four.

cards.fr: Ici, on déjeune jusqu’à quinze heures.
cards.en: Here, people have lunch until three p.m.

cards.fr: Si la cuisine ferme, on peut encore prendre un café.
cards.en: If the kitchen closes, you can still have a coffee.
Does the kitchen reopen this evening?

cards.fr: À quelle heure prenez-vous la dernière commande ?
cards.en: At what time do you take the last order?

cards.fr: Je vais vérifier les horaires avec le serveur.
cards.en: I will check the hours with the server.

cards.fr: Le service du soir commence à dix-neuf heures.
cards.en: Evening service starts at seven p.m.

cards.fr: Après le repas, on peut rester à table pour discuter.
cards.en: After the meal, we can stay at the table to talk.

reader.speaker: Femke
reader.fr: Pourquoi la cuisine ferme-t-elle à seize heures ?
reader.en: Why does the kitchen close at four p.m.?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Dans ce café, le service du midi se termine à seize heures.
reader.en: At this café, lunch service ends at four p.m.

reader.speaker: Femke
reader.fr: Est-ce qu’on reste à table après le repas ?
reader.en: Do people stay at the table after the meal?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Ici, oui : on peut rester à table pour discuter.
reader.en: Here, yes: we can stay at the table to talk.

reader.speaker: Femke
reader.fr: Alors, si nous arrivons après, pouvons-nous encore prendre un café ?
reader.en: So if we arrive later, can we still have a coffee?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Je pense que oui. Je vais vérifier les horaires avec le serveur.
reader.en: I think so. I will check the hours with the server.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Excusez-moi. À quelle heure prenez-vous la dernière commande ?
reader.en: Excuse me. At what time do you take the last order?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: À quinze heures trente. La cuisine ferme à seize heures.
reader.en: At three thirty. The kitchen closes at four.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: La cuisine rouvre-t-elle ce soir ?
reader.en: Does the kitchen reopen this evening?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui, le service du soir commence à dix-neuf heures. La terrasse reste ouverte pour les cafés cet après-midi.
reader.en: Yes, evening service starts at seven. The terrace stays open for coffee this afternoon.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Femke, nous pouvons prendre un café sur la terrasse, puis revenir ce soir.
reader.en: Femke, we can have coffee on the terrace, then come back this evening.

speaking.opening: Dans ce café, le service du midi se termine à seize heures.
speaking.goal: Explain this café’s lunch closure and after-meal conversation, check the last order and evening reopening with staff, then tell the traveler what remains available.
speaking.closure: On peut prendre un café sur la terrasse maintenant.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French term for the last order.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall the conditional sentence about coffee after kitchen closure.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the evening reopening question.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French verb to reopen.

say.cueEnglish: Ask staff when the last order is taken.

write.cueEnglish: Write the café-specific evening service time.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Coach a Friend Through Ordering at a Busy Taco Stand
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Coach a friend with short commands on how to order, add salsas and pay at a crowded stand, then let them do it.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are coaching the AI, your Japanese friend Aiko, at a busy taco stand in Mexico City: tell her how to order, add salsas and pay with short commands like pídelo con todo, pruébala primero and no la toques, then let her order on her own.
lessons.title: Coach a Friend at a Busy Crêpe Stand
lessons.objective: Coach a friend to order a savory crêpe, choose a sauce and pay at a crowded counter, then let her order herself.
lessons.focus: Use short imperative forms with object pronouns: commande-la, ajoute-en, goûte-la and garde-les.
lessons.scene: At a busy market crêpe stand, Maya helps Aiko order and then steps back.

cards.fr: Ajoute une sauce si tu veux.
cards.en: Add a sauce if you want.

cards.fr: Demande le prix avant de payer.
Je voudrais une galette au fromage et aux champignons.
cards.en: I would like a buckwheat crêpe with cheese and mushrooms.

reader.speaker: Aiko
reader.fr: La file avance vite. Qu’est-ce que je dis ?
reader.en: The line is moving fast. What do I say?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Choisis la galette au fromage et aux champignons. Commande-la au comptoir.
reader.en: Choose the buckwheat crêpe with cheese and mushrooms. Order it at the counter.

reader.speaker: Aiko
reader.fr: Et la sauce ?
reader.en: And the sauce?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Ajoute une sauce si tu veux. Demande le prix avant de payer.
reader.en: Add a sauce if you want. Ask the price before paying.

reader.speaker: Aiko
reader.fr: D’accord. Je vais commander toute seule.
reader.en: All right. I will order by myself.

reader.speaker: Aiko
reader.fr: Bonjour. Je voudrais une galette au fromage et aux champignons.
reader.en: Hello. I would like a buckwheat crêpe with cheese and mushrooms.

reader.speaker: Vendor
reader.fr: Bien sûr. Voulez-vous une sauce ? Ça fait huit euros sans sauce.
reader.en: Of course. Would you like a sauce? It comes to eight euros without sauce.

reader.speaker: Aiko
reader.fr: Non merci. Voici huit euros.
reader.en: No thank you. Here are eight euros.

reader.speaker: Vendor
reader.fr: Merci. Voici votre galette et votre monnaie.
reader.en: Thank you. Here is your buckwheat crêpe and your change.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bravo. Tu l’as commandée toi-même.
reader.en: Well done. You ordered it yourself.

speaking.opening: Choisis la galette au fromage et aux champignons.
speaking.goal: Give brief ordering, sauce and payment instructions, then let the friend make the final order and payment.
wordBank: Ajoute une sauce si tu veux.
Demande le prix avant de payer.
Je voudrais une galette au fromage et aux champignons.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French term for a buckwheat crêpe.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall the command to order it at the counter.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the instruction to taste it first.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for filling.

say.cueEnglish: Coach your friend to ask the price before paying.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The stand, filling, price and pace are fictional. Review imperative pronouns and spoken register; French scene replaces Mexican taco specifics while preserving the coaching purpose.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Read the Allergen Chart Before Ordering for the Group
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Read a restaurant's allergen chart with the server and explain to the group what to ask before ordering.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are reading the allergen chart in a Barcelona bistro, and the AI is server Jordi and your friend Priya, who avoids tree nuts: ask what the symbols and warnings mean, then tell Priya what to check before ordering, using antes de + infinitive and hay que.
lessons.title: Read the Allergen Chart for the Group
lessons.objective: Read an allergen chart with a server, ask about tree nuts and traces, and explain the chart’s wording to the group before ordering.
lessons.focus: Use avant de + infinitive and il faut to sequence chart reading, direct ingredient questions and reporting what staff say.
lessons.scene: At a bistro, Maya reads the allergen chart with the server for her friend Priya, who avoids tree nuts.

cards.fr: Avant de commander, il faut lire la carte des allergènes.
cards.en: Before ordering, we need to read the allergen chart.

cards.fr: Ce plat contient-il des fruits à coque ?
cards.en: Does this dish contain tree nuts?

cards.fr: La carte indique des traces de noisettes.
cards.en: The chart indicates traces of hazelnuts.
Can you ask in the kitchen?

cards.fr: Je vais expliquer à Priya ce que la carte indique.
cards.en: I will explain to Priya what the chart says.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Avant de commander, il faut lire la carte des allergènes.
reader.en: Before ordering, we need to read the allergen chart.

reader.speaker: Priya
reader.fr: Que signifie ce symbole à côté du dessert ?
reader.en: What does that symbol beside the dessert mean?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Je vais demander au serveur. Excusez-moi, que signifie ce symbole ?
reader.en: I will ask the server. Excuse me, what does that symbol mean?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Il indique des fruits à coque. La carte mentionne aussi des traces de noisettes.
reader.en: It indicates tree nuts. The chart also mentions traces of hazelnuts.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Ce plat contient-il des amandes ou des pistaches ?
reader.en: Does this dish contain almonds or pistachios?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: La carte ne liste ni amandes ni pistaches pour ce plat. Je vais demander en cuisine pour la préparation.
reader.en: The chart lists neither almonds nor pistachios for this dish. I will ask in the kitchen about preparation.

reader.speaker: Priya
reader.fr: Qu’avons-nous appris jusqu’ici ?
reader.en: What have we learned so far?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Le symbole indique des fruits à coque et la carte mentionne des traces de noisettes. Le serveur vérifie la préparation.
reader.en: The symbol indicates tree nuts and the chart mentions traces of hazelnuts. The server is checking the preparation.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: La cuisine confirme que ce dessert contient des noisettes.
reader.en: The kitchen confirms that this dessert contains hazelnuts.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Priya, ce dessert contient des noisettes.
reader.en: Priya, this dessert contains hazelnuts.

speaking.goal: Read the symbols, ask directly about tree nuts and traces, ask staff about preparation, and tell Priya exactly what the chart and server say.
speaking.closure: Priya, ce dessert contient des noisettes.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall the question about an allergen symbol.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the chart’s hazelnut-traces wording.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for pistachios.

say.cueEnglish: Ask the server whether the dish contains tree nuts.

write.cueEnglish: Write how to explain the chart’s statement to Priya.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Hidden Chicken Stock in the Vegetarian Soup
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Tell the cook what you ordered and what you were told, and propose a fair fix for your vegetarian friend.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are eating with your vegetarian friend Tomás, and the AI is Doña Felisa, the cook: calmly explain what you ordered and what you were told with pedimos and nos dijeron que era, then propose a fair fix with ¿podría…?
lessons.title: Resolve Chicken Stock in Vegetarian Soup
lessons.objective: Explain that the soup was ordered as vegetarian but contains chicken stock, recount what the table was told, and propose a fair replacement.
lessons.focus: Use passé composé for the order and imparfait for what was described; use pourriez-vous for the proposed fix.
lessons.scene: Maya speaks with the cook after her vegetarian friend Tom discovers chicken stock in a vegetable soup.

cards.fr: Nous avons commandé une soupe végétarienne.
On nous a dit qu’elle était préparée avec un bouillon de légumes.
cards.en: We were told it was made with vegetable stock.

cards.fr: Cette soupe contient du bouillon de poulet.
Pourriez-vous lui préparer un autre plat sans viande ?
cards.en: Could you prepare another dish without meat for him?

cards.fr: Nous voudrions comprendre ce qui s’est passé.
cards.en: We would like to understand what happened.
Thank you for replacing the soup.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bonjour. Nous avons commandé une soupe végétarienne pour mon ami Tom.
reader.en: Hello. We ordered a vegetarian soup for my friend Tom.

reader.speaker: Cook
reader.fr: Oui. Quel est le problème ?
reader.en: Yes. What is the problem?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: On nous a dit qu’elle était préparée avec un bouillon de légumes.
reader.en: We were told it was made with vegetable stock.

reader.speaker: Tom
reader.fr: Mais cette soupe contient du bouillon de poulet, n’est-ce pas ?
reader.en: But this soup contains chicken stock, does it not?

reader.speaker: Cook
reader.fr: Oui. Je suis désolée, il y a eu un malentendu.
reader.en: Yes. I am sorry, there was a misunderstanding.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Tom est végétarien. Nous voudrions comprendre ce qui s’est passé.
reader.en: Tom is vegetarian. We would like to understand what happened.

reader.speaker: Cook
reader.fr: Le bouillon de poulet a été utilisé pour cette soupe aujourd’hui.
reader.en: Chicken stock was used for this soup today.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Pourriez-vous lui préparer un autre plat sans viande ?
reader.en: Could you prepare another dish without meat for him?

reader.speaker: Cook
reader.fr: Oui. Je peux lui préparer une salade avec une vinaigrette sans viande.
reader.en: Yes. I can prepare him a salad with a dressing without meat.

reader.speaker: Tom
reader.fr: Merci. La salade me convient.
reader.en: Thank you. The salad works for me.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci de remplacer la soupe.
reader.en: Thank you for replacing the soup.

speaking.opening: Nous avons commandé une soupe végétarienne pour mon ami.
speaking.goal: State the order and earlier description, identify the chicken stock, ask what happened and propose a meat-free replacement acceptable to the friend.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall how to state the original vegetarian-soup order.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the sentence about vegetable stock.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for misunderstanding.

write.cueEnglish: Write a conditional request for another meat-free dish.

internalReviewNotes: Master 1–5 preserve exact Spanish Master learning purposes with original French scenes and language-specific grammar. The Mexican taco setting in source Master 3 becomes a French crêpe stand while retaining coaching, sauce and payment.
Qualified French and relevant food-allergen, cultural and domain review remain required; all lessons are private and unregistered.
